text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D and Stock E at gains felt satisfying, but I should not sell just to lock in a profit; decisions should reflect each stock’s future prospects and my plan.","A falling account value is uncomfortable, but it does not by itself show that a holding was a mistake. I should assess each position on its merits rather than cling to its purchase price.","Past price moves have no reliable power to predict the next move, so I should avoid reacting to short-term swings and trade only when my goals or evidence justify it."]}
